lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In earlier times in Israel, for the redemption and transfer of property to become final, one party took off his sandal and gave it to the other. This was the method of legalizing transactions in Israel.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So the guardian-redeemer said to Boaz, 'Buy it yourself,' and removed his sandal.

lines.speaker: boaz
lines.text: Today you are witnesses that I have bought from Naomi all the property of Elimelek, Kilion and Mahlon. I have also acquired Ruth the Moabite, Mahlon's widow, as my wife, so that the name of the dead may be maintained with his property.

choices.label: Transfer the sandal
choices.note: The agreement is sealed before the elders.

choices.label: Join the households
choices.note: Ruth and Naomi are bound together in redemption.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The elders and all the people at the gate said, 'We are witnesses. May the LORD make the woman who is coming into your home like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the house of Israel.'

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Boaz married Ruth. She bore a son. The women said to Naomi, 'Praise be to the LORD, who this day has not left you without a guardian-redeemer.'
